_comment: Each 4x4 tile has its own maze-like wall layout. Sand timers, items, and vortexes preferentially sit in nooks (cells with multiple adjacent walls), never in a hallway where they would be forced to be stepped on. EACH escalator must connect two cells that are in SEPARATE connected components — the escalator is the only intra-tile link between them. Hallway tiles (T04, T10) use an offset door pattern (N/S or E/W doors on different cols/rows) so chained hallways never form a straight line. Encoding: 'NESW[:features]' where N/E/S/W are wall chars (. = open, # = wall) and walls are symmetrized at load time. Feature codes: iy/ip/ig/io=item, ey/ep/eg/eo=exit, vy/vp/vg/vo=vortex, xy/xp/xg/xo=explore door, st=start, t=sand timer, c=crystal ball, cam=camera, dp=dwarf passage.

tiles._comment: Starting tile. 2x2 START block in the middle; one colored explore door on each of the 4 edges.
Yellow item + green vortex. L-shaped room: item (1,2) in NE nook (2 walls), vortex (2,1) in mid-row. 3 doors (N/E/S); the W edge is walled.

Purple item + sand timer + orange vortex. Inner partition: timer (1,1) in a 2-walled nook, item (1,2) in a 2-walled nook on the other side, orange vortex (2,2) in a corner-ish pocket. 3 doors (N/E/S); W walled.

Green item — Z-bend corridor. N door at col 1, S door at col 2 so a chain of T04s never lines up perfectly (offset by 1 column each placement). Path: (0,1)->(1,1)->(2,1)->(2,2)->(3,2). Chest in 3-walled alcove at (1,2), reachable only via (1,1) — never on a forced path.

Orange item + sand timer + orange vortex + diagonal escalator. Two SEPARATE connected components: NW {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1)} (item io at NW corner, N door, W door) and SE {(0,3),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3)} (vortex vo at (0,3), S door, sand timer at (3,3)). Pillars at (0,2),(1,2),(2,1) and a wall between (3,1)/(3,2) cut all walking routes. Escalator (1,1)<->(2,2) is the ONLY intra-tile link.

Yellow + Purple exits. Central 2x2 pillar at (1,1)-(2,2) forces heroes around the perimeter ring. Exits (1,0) ey and (1,3) ep sit in the side nooks beside the pillar; both exit cells have walled perimeters so heroes can't escape until they actually reach Phase 2 and exit. 3 doors (N/S/W); E walled.

Green + Orange exits + sand timer. The timer at (2,1) is walled on N/E/S — a 3-walled dead-end pocket reachable only as an opt-in side trip, not on any forced path. 3 doors (N/S/W); E walled so heroes don't slip out the east edge.

Vortex hall: two SEALED pockets reachable ONLY by diagonal escalator. (0,3) is a 1-cell pocket with vortex vy; (3,0) is a 1-cell pocket with vortex vp. Main area is the rest of the tile (with N/E/S doors). Heroes must escalator in to teleport, then escalator back.

Vortex hall: Green + Orange vortexes + Crystal Ball + diagonal escalator. (1,0) is a SEALED 1-cell pocket with vortex vg, linked ONLY by escalator (1,0)<->(2,1). Crystal Ball at (1,2), vortex vo at (2,2). 3 doors (N/E/S); W walled.

Horizontal Z-bend corridor with sand timer. W door at row 1, E door at row 2 so a chain of T10s never lines up perfectly (offset by 1 row each placement). Path: (1,0)->(1,1)->(2,1)->(2,2)->(2,3). Sand timer at (0,1) in 3-walled alcove off the corridor — heroes must deliberately step up into it.

Yellow vortex + Crystal Ball + Green vortex + diagonal escalator. (0,0) is a SEALED 1-cell pocket linked ONLY by escalator (0,0)<->(1,1). vy at (1,0), Crystal Ball at (1,2), vg at (3,3). Pillar at (2,1). 3 doors (N/E/S); W walled.

Vortex pinwheel: Purple + Orange vortexes. Two SEPARATE connected components: NW {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0),(3,0),(3,1)} (N door, W door, orange vortex vo at (3,1)) and SE {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3)} (S door, purple vortex vp at (1,2)). Pillar at (2,1) plus walls between (0,1)/(0,2), (1,1)/(1,2), (3,1)/(3,2) cut the halves apart. Escalator (1,1)<->(2,2) is the only intra-tile link.
